meta.title: Break-even backed shares (S82): scanning down from full backing, where each reading's effect is no better than no programme, and where programme inflation reaches 5 points a year; "none on the grid" where no grid point reaches it (never extrapolated)
meta.intervals: 95% paired-bootstrap intervals over seeds 1-500 (10,000 replicates); the model's randomness only
meta.limit: the supply limit cuts only the housing, care and food households receive; the money left over goes to other goods and the cut moves no price, so wealth, basic living and inflation are the same with and without it
